faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about resizing video online
faq.q1: How do I resize video from landscape to portrait without cropping important parts?
faq.a1: Select the 9:16 vertical preset and choose 'Blur'. This scales your original horizontal video to fit cleanly within the vertical canvas while automatically filling the top and bottom with a soft, blurred duplicate of the video.
faq.q2: What size should I resize a video to for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels?
faq.a2: All three vertical short-form platforms require a 9:16 aspect ratio (recommended resolution: 1080 x 1920 pixels).
faq.q3: Will the quality drop when I resize video?
faq.a3: Resizing re-encodes the video on your device, so some change is normal, and upscaling a small video cannot add detail. For the best result, start from your highest-quality original. When the audio codec matches the container, such as AAC in MP4, the audio is copied without re-encoding.
faq.q4: Is video resize online safe for private clips?
faq.a4: With AspectCut, your file is not uploaded. It is resized inside your browser, so the clip is never sent to a server.
faq.q5: Which video formats and file sizes can I resize?
faq.a5: You can resize MP4, MOV, WebM, and MKV videos up to 500 MB.
faq.q6: Is it free to resize video online?
faq.a6: Yes. You can resize video online with AspectCut for free. You don't need an account, and there is no watermark on the exported file.
faq.q7: How does the blurred background work when I resize a video?
faq.a7: AspectCut keeps your whole video centered in the new frame and places an enlarged, blurred copy behind it, so the empty space is filled without black bars.
faq.q8: Can I resize a video on iPhone or Android?
faq.a8: Yes. AspectCut works in mobile browsers with WebCodecs support, such as Android Chrome and recent versions of iOS Safari, so you can resize video online without installing an app.
